import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Constants
ARRAY_SIZE = 10000


def task_func():
    """
    Generate random integers, compute mean and standard deviation,
    and plot their histogram.

    Returns:
        tuple: (array, mean, standard_deviation, ax)
    """
    # Generate random integers between 1 and 100 inclusive
    array = np.random.randint(1, 101, size=ARRAY_SIZE)

    # Calculate statistics
    mean = np.mean(array)
    std_dev = np.std(array)

    # Create histogram
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 6))
    ax.hist(array, bins=range(1, 102), edgecolor="black", alpha=0.75)

    # Add mean line
    ax.axvline(mean, color="red", linestyle="--", linewidth=2, label="Mean")

    # Add standard deviation lines
    ax.axvline(mean - std_dev, color="purple", linestyle="--", linewidth=2, label="Std Dev")
    ax.axvline(mean + std_dev, color="purple", linestyle="--", linewidth=2)

    # Labels and title
    ax.set_title("Histogram of Random Integers")
    ax.set_xlabel("Value")
    ax.set_ylabel("Frequency")
    ax.legend()

    return array, mean, std_dev, ax
